motion.note: Not a confirmed measurement: the source is found in only 37 of 150 images; only 2 epochs with a position; the brightness changes 2.1-fold between visits at a typical wavelength (the median over all wavelength bins of this detector; in a single bin the change can be larger), so the image centre can shift without any real motion if the source is an unresolved pair. The star saturates the detector; positions come from the wings of its image.

method: pixel-integrated Gaussian fit on raw cutouts, median per epoch

source.archive: NASA/IPAC IRSA, SPHEREx Level 2 spectral image cutouts
